page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re8.120xlarge is an ultra-high-density memory-optimized cloud server built for large-scale enterprise workloads requiring substantial memory footprints and high parallel processing capability. Provisioned on the KVM hypervisor, this instance features 480 dedicated vCPUs driven by x86_64 Intel Xeon 8490H processors running at a base clock frequency of 1.9 GHz. It delivers 8192.0 GB of system RAM, yielding a high memory density of approximately 17.07 GB per vCPU. The instance does not include integrated GPUs.

Network infrastructure on the ecs.re8.120xlarge is provisioned with a 128 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, accommodating heavy node-to-node throughput and massive distributed traffic. Local storage is not bundled, meaning external block storage volumes must be attached for persistent file systems. Operating the instance without local disks provides architectural flexibility, though it requires relying entirely on network-attached storage or in-memory operations for primary execution.

Cost efficiency is dictated by the consolidation of enterprise memory and compute capacity into a single dedicated resource pool. Instead of partitioning workloads across clustered smaller nodes, the unified 8192.0 GB memory architecture eliminates interconnect latency for monolithic datasets, lowering cluster management overhead while maximizing per-core memory capacity. The instance is suited for massive in-memory databases like SAP HANA or Redis, large enterprise resource planning engines, high-volume ETL pipelines, and comprehensive real-time transactional analytics.
